what: Edge zlib inflate task (edgezlib_inflate_task.cpp, zlib 1.2.3.0-PS3-SPU-EDGE), a SPURS task image at LS 0x3000, entry 0x3090; found by the unknown-job dump of console run rv39s (job:d97a9a91, 13.8 G interpreted instructions)

SPURS policy module pm_wwsjob (libsre WWS job policy module), the blob the SPURS kernel DMAs to LS 0xA00 (EBOOT.elf 0x68C880, 0x2D80 bytes); entry 0x2BF0. CODE ranges [0xA00,0xB00) interrupt glue and [0x1600,0x3728); the variables and tables between them change at run time and are not part of its identity. Function 0x31C8 is the job call (bisle $lr,$r5): the job-window hook sits there.

SPURS task-set policy module of libsre.prx (body at libsre image 0x23680, 0x1E40 bytes at LS 0xA00, entry 0xA00); code [0xA00,0x2680) is constant at run time (checked against a console LS dump), its variables [0x2680,0x2840) are not part of its identity. It runs the Edge zlib task and has no job-call hook function: a task is entered by an indirect branch to a task entry, which is a lifted transfer when the task module is armed (composite) and an escape to the interpreter otherwise.

SPURS system service module of libsre.prx (body at libsre image 0x21480, 0x2200 bytes at LS 0xA00, entry 0xA00); code [0xA00,0x2B10). The kernel runs it when no workload is ready: its idle wait (RdEventStat with LR) is where parked threads sit. No job-call hook.
